description: Give a Rust weather Reading struct first-class traits: implement std::fmt::Display for unit-aware output written with write!, std::str::FromStr with a ParseReadingError instead of the panicking helper, and load the batch via ? in main, with no .expect() left in src/main.rs.

criteria: src/main.rs implements fmt::Display for Reading with unit-aware output built from write! inside a fmt::Result-returning fmt function, implements FromStr for Reading with a ParseReadingError so malformed collector lines become Err values instead of panics, loads the batch through a fallible loader that uses ?, keeps print_reading as a thin wrapper over the Display impl, and contains no .expect() call, with the README untouched.
